_doc: Curated price SELECTION for BOM27 (Step 27 rev 10). Every row points at one entry of research/pricing_2026-10.json by (pn, vendor) and make_bom.py refuses to run if that entry is missing or its price differs. basis: EXACT = same manufacturer part number; EQUIV = stated equivalent (same function/size, different grade, pack or listing) - the reason is in 'why'; NONE = no public price was obtainable read-only (status says why). Public list prices, retrieved 2026-10-02, USD, excluding tax and freight unless stated. Nothing was ordered, no quote requested. Rev 11 (task 139737, 2026-10-06): lines plf_lock and crossbar_reference are public list prices read 2026-10-06; other PLF lines are NONE with the reason. Weistec port_adapter is kept below only as the documented fallback; it is not in the primary BOM.
